{{Attr|Bloated}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Eclipsed''' was an enemy that appeared in [[Containment]] as part of the [[Hexscape Event]]. It had a high amount of health, high defense and walked at an average pace. It had [[Freeze Immunity]] and [[Stun Immunity]], making it harder to slow down. ==Appearance== The '''Eclipsed''' had brown skin and one, large yellow glowing eye on its head. It wore a grey chestplate and shoulder-pads, and brown belt. It had multiple yellow glowing eyes on its torso. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers, like the [[Engineer]], [[Ranger]] or [[Accelerator]], can be quite effective against this. *As it has quite high defense, defense dropping towers like the [[Pyromancer]] or [[DJ Booth]] can allow your towers to deal more damage to it. **Freeze defense dropping towers cannot drop its defense, as it has the [[Freeze Immunity]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} EclipsedWalk.gif|Walking animation (30 October 2024 – 20 November 2024) EclipsedStun.gif|Stun animation (30 October 2024 – 20 November 2024) }} ==Trivia== *The '''Eclipsed''' bears some resemblance to the [[Swamp Monster]]. ==Update History== *'''30 October 2024''' - [[v1.39.0]] **'''Eclipsed''' added. **{{Bug}} Poison and electric defense dropping does not decrease '''Eclipsed's''' defense. *'''6 November 2024''' - [[v1.40.0]] **{{Bugfix}} Poison and electric defense dropping now drops '''Eclipsed's''' defense, though the [[Jester]] still cannot drop it. *'''20 November 2024''' - [[v1.42.0]] **'''Eclipsed''' removed. {{Containment|[[Enigma (Hexscape)|Enigma]]|Wave 17 (Easy)|hardt1 = [[Conjurer (Hexscape)|Conjurer]] & [[Enigma (Hexscape)|Enigma]]|hardw1 = Wave 17 (Hard)|Eclipsed|Wave 18|[[Hex Drako]]|Wave 19}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Eclipsed}}
